bug_semantics: Proxy and hook auto-provisioning apply the CLI default scope '.' and pass it to MakeUserDir without clearing it when createUserDir is enabled. MakeUserDir only derives /users/<username> for an empty scope, so '.' normalizes to '/', every provisioned non-admin user is saved with the server-root scope, and one valid upstream identity can read, modify, delete, and share other users' files.
flaw_origin: dda9a389f387e94643a9a2ae56027260b210152a first added auth/hook.go SaveUser, which copies Settings.Defaults.Scope (CLI default '.') onto new users and calls MakeUserDir without the empty-scope CreateUserDir branch. That is the first write of the advisory's auto-provision root-scope path; the later proxy auto-create in 209acf24/PR #3569 repeats the same call pattern.
